title: The Writing on the Wall

questions.question: Which king made a great feast for a thousand of his lords?
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:1 (ESV): "King Belshazzar made a great feast for a thousand of his lords"

questions.question: What vessels did they drink from at the feast?
options: Gold and silver vessels from the temple in Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: Gold and silver vessels from the temple in Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:2 (ESV): "to bring the gold and silver vessels that Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple in Jerusalem,"

questions.question: What appeared and wrote on the plaster of the wall of the king's palace?
options: The fingers of a human hand
questions.correctAnswer: The fingers of a human hand
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:5 (ESV): "Immediately the fingers of a human hand appeared and wrote on the plaster of the wall"

questions.question: What was the king's reaction when he saw the hand writing?
options: His color changed, his thoughts alarmed him, his limbs gave way, and his knees knocked together
questions.correctAnswer: His color changed, his thoughts alarmed him, his limbs gave way, and his knees knocked together
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:6 (ESV): "Then the king's color changed, and his thoughts alarmed him; his limbs gave way, and his knees knocked together."

questions.question: Who advised the king to call for Daniel?
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:10 (ESV): "The queen... came into the banquet hall, and... said... let Daniel be called,"

questions.question: What did the writing on the wall say?
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:25 (ESV): "And this is the writing that was inscribed: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, and PARSIN."

questions.question: What does "Mene" mean?
options: God has numbered the days of your kingdom and brought it to an end
You have been weighed in the balances
questions.correctAnswer: God has numbered the days of your kingdom and brought it to an end
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:26 (ESV): "MENE, God has numbered the days of your kingdom and brought it to an end;"

questions.question: What does "Tekel" mean?
options: You have been weighed in the balances and found wanting
questions.correctAnswer: You have been weighed in the balances and found wanting
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:27 (ESV): "TEKEL, you have been weighed in the balances and found wanting;"

questions.question: What does "Peres" (singular of Parsin) mean?
options: Your kingdom is divided and given to the Medes and Persians
questions.correctAnswer: Your kingdom is divided and given to the Medes and Persians
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:28 (ESV): "PERES, your kingdom is divided and given to the Medes and Persians."

questions.question: Who received the kingdom after Belshazzar was killed that same night?
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:30-31 (ESV): "That very night Belshazzar the Chaldean king was killed. And Darius the Mede received the kingdom,"

questions.question: What did Daniel say regarding the king's gifts?
options: Let your gifts be for yourself
questions.correctAnswer: Let your gifts be for yourself
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:17 (ESV): "Then Daniel answered and said before the king, 'Let your gifts be for yourself, and give your rewards to another.'"

questions.question: Why did Daniel say God sent the hand to write?
options: Because Belshazzar lifted himself up against the Lord of heaven and did not humble his heart
Because Belshazzar was a bad king
Because of the wise men's failure
questions.correctAnswer: Because Belshazzar lifted himself up against the Lord of heaven and did not humble his heart
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:22-23 (ESV): "And you his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart... but you have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven."

questions.question: How old was Darius the Mede when he received the kingdom?
What did Belshazzar promise to whoever could read the writing?
options: Purple clothing, a chain of gold, and rank of third ruler in the kingdom
questions.correctAnswer: Purple clothing, a chain of gold, and rank of third ruler in the kingdom
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:7 (ESV): "shall be clothed with purple and have a chain of gold around his neck and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom."

questions.question: Who did Daniel remind Belshazzar of, who had been humbled by God?
questions.explanation: Daniel 5:18 (ESV): "O king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father kingship and greatness"

key_verse_text: TEKEL, you have been weighed in the balances and found wanting;
